maya_research: Heads-up: onboarding run for spectrum32k-int4-spline produced tiny but consistent token jitter and small phase shear near shard-join boundaries (~20k tokens). Repro + logs below.
nate_infra: paste serve args + image tag and which cluster so we can repro.
maya_research: serve: `./serve --model spectrum32k-int4-spline --kv-mode shear-remap --prefill-mode spline-bucket --prefill-stride=2 --quant=int4_spline --meta-compress=true` image: gh/onboard/spectrum-int4:try-11 cluster: ded-5
olga_eval: sample mismatch (fp16 vs int4-spline):
```
FP16: "The symposium concluded on April 2, 2026, after five sessions."
INT4-SPLINE: "The symposium concluded on April 2 2026 after five sessions."
```
olga_eval: pattern: dropped comma and occasional subtle reordering near long date/person spans. goldset perp: fp16=6.3 int4-spline=9.8 (8 anchors).
paul_platform: Any kv-checksums or index maps? If shear-remap path changes logical->physical mapping we might be applying RoPE before remap.
maya_research: kv-checksum: fp16=0x6d2f88a1, int4-spline(shear-remap)=0x95b4c7e2, int4-spline(no-shear)=0x6d2f88a1. ran `rope-spline-diff --fp fp16 --quant int4-spline --window 22000` -> max shear ~0.0029 rad at pos 19968 (matches shard join).
nate_infra: can you run `kv-mapping-dump --range 19936..20000 --format=logical->physical` on both runs and paste excerpt?
maya_research: pasted excerpt: `fp16:19936->0x7a,19937->0x7b,...20000->0x80` 
`int4-spline(shear):19936->0x79,19937->0x7b,...20000->0x7f` <-- shows alternating offsets around join, not monotonic.
paul_platform: That alternating offset smells like a fold+shear remap bug when stride=2. Hypothesis: remap interleaves shard halves but RoPE applied to pre-remap indices. Quick mitigation: set `--prefill-stride=1` or disable `--kv-mode shear-remap` for canary and run goldset.
olga_eval: I ran a quick canary locally with shear-remap off: fp16 perp=6.4 int4-spline(no-shear)=6.7. So disabling remap fixes quality.
ci-bot: build 20444: gh/onboard/spectrum-int4:try-11 pushed to canary cluster c-2 :white_check_mark:
paul_platform: Plan: (1) revert shear-remap in canary if goldset in staging fails; (2) add unit test: synthetic KV with stride=2 interleaving assert remap->rope equivalence; (3) fix code path to remap indices before computing RoPE multipliers.
maya_research: I'll run deterministic seed with remap disabled and post rope-spline-diffs + updated goldset numbers. If confirmed, I'll open PR titled "fix(kv): compute RoPE after shear-remap interleave to avoid phase shear" with unit tests.
nate_infra: please include small kernel test that checks mapping monotonicity post-remap. If canary shows regression, prioritize revert.
maya_research: thanks 44D kicking off runs now, will paste diffs and a short sample patch snippet once ready.
